title: Assess hardening against unsupported external live-file ABA in Unix delegation loading
outcome: Assess additional protection against repeated externally orchestrated rename/unlink/replacement/restore of an in-use SQLite source between separate VFS and pathname observations. This concerns unsupported external live-file operations only. Any counterexample reachable through supported TermAl lifecycle or persistence operations remains in scope and blocking for the parent; this follow-up grants no waiver or automatic severity downgrade.
acceptance: Strengthen Unix delegation source binding against repeated pathname ABA between VFS observations is done
